items.title: Will PYPL Stock's Multiple Catch Up?
items.summary: PayPal (PYPL) trades at $61.55 per share on a $54.0B market cap and 11.0x trailing earnings. Under a conservative 3-year scenario, the math points to roughly 28% upside. items.title: Visa Charges Toward New All-Time Closing High
items.summary: Visa shares jumped about 3% Monday, netting the payments giant a new all-time closing high, based on data going back to 2008. Shares closed at $182.41. The gain landed Visa its fifth consecutive winning day; shares climbed about 6.

items.summary: The Dow Jones average rises but other indexes fall as President Trump lashes out at Canada. Nvidia dives but a stock clears an entry.

items.title: Why Hims & Hers Health (HIMS) Stock Is Nosediving
items.summary: Shares of telehealth company Hims & Hers Health (NYSE:HIMS) fell 9.2% in the afternoon session after Bloomberg reported that Visa enrolled the telehealth company in its Acquirer Monitoring Program following a surge in customer credit card disputes in its weight-loss subscription business.
